title: spa_react_javascript_auth0
one_liner: Auth0 React SPA authentication sample with auxiliary S3 audio upload utilities.
what_it_is: A reference implementation demonstrating how to integrate Auth0 user authentication into a React Single-Page Application using React Router 6. The repository also contains standalone JavaScript modules for recording audio, managing an upload queue, and uploading files to AWS S3 via presigned URLs, though these are distinct from the core authentication logic.
how_its_built: The application is built with React and React Router 6 for client-side routing. It uses the Auth0 React SDK (@auth0/auth0-react) to handle login, logout, and user profile management. The auxiliary audio features use the Web MediaRecorder API, standard Fetch API for S3 interactions, and vanilla JavaScript for queue management.
how_to_apply: Use this project as a starting point for adding secure user authentication to React applications. Developers can copy the Auth0 configuration patterns and protected route wrappers. The audio modules can be reused in projects requiring client-side voice recording and direct-to-S3 uploads.
features: User login and logout via Auth0 Universal Login
Protected routes using React Router 6 and Auth0 context
User profile display and session management
Client-side audio recording using MediaRecorder API
Queue-based upload system for audio blobs
